summary: Linked-list traversal: saves the head pointer (this[6]) into the traversal cursor (this[8]), then walks nodes via their next pointers calling ConditionalMatchTrigger on each node's stored value with parameter a2. Returns the final cursor value. Called once from SettingsSaveWrapper during settings save.

operations.description: Load head pointer from this[6] and store it into traversal cursor this[8].
If head pointer (this[6]) is null, skip traversal and return null.
Dereference the head node to obtain the first dword (node value) held by the head node's data object.
Iterate nodes while the current node pointer is non-null, advancing by following each node's next pointer.
Call ConditionalMatchTrigger(result, a2) on the current node's value.
Reload cursor from this[8], advance to the next node via the node's second dword (next pointer), and write the new cursor back to this[8]. Break if the cursor becomes null.
Return the final cursor value (last node pointer, or null when traversal ended).
